meanings.en: a person trained to treat mental or physical illness
meanings.exampleEn: She sees a therapist once a week to deal with her anxiety.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaygısıyla başa çıkmak için haftada bir kez terapiste gidiyor.

meanings.en: treatment for a physical or mental condition
meanings.exampleEn: He started therapy after the accident to recover his movement.
meanings.exampleTr: Hareketini geri kazanmak için kazadan sonra terapiye başladı.

meanings.en: after that time
meanings.exampleEn: He graduated in 2010 and thereafter moved abroad.
meanings.exampleTr: 2010'da mezun oldu ve ondan sonra yurt dışına taşındı.

meanings.en: an instrument for measuring temperature
meanings.exampleEn: The nurse used a thermometer to check the baby's temperature.
meanings.exampleTr: Hemşire bebeğin ateşini ölçmek için termometre kullandı.

meanings.en: a long written piece of research for a university degree
meanings.exampleEn: She spent two years writing her doctoral thesis.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktora tezini yazmak için iki yıl harcadı.

meanings.en: in a thick or dense way
meanings.exampleEn: She spread the butter thickly on the bread.
meanings.exampleTr: Tereyağını ekmeğin üzerine kalın bir şekilde sürdü.

meanings.en: the distance between two opposite surfaces of something
meanings.exampleEn: The thickness of the ice was enough to walk on.
meanings.exampleTr: Buzun kalınlığı üzerinde yürümeye yetecek kadardı.

meanings.en: the part of the leg between the hip and the knee
meanings.exampleEn: He injured his thigh while playing football.
meanings.exampleTr: Futbol oynarken uyluğunu sakatladı.

meanings.en: a person who thinks deeply or has important ideas
meanings.exampleEn: Aristotle was one of the greatest thinkers of all time.
meanings.exampleTr: Aristoteles tüm zamanların en büyük düşünürlerinden biriydi.

meanings.en: the grammatical form used to refer to people being spoken about
meanings.exampleEn: The novel is written in the third person, so the narrator is not a character.
meanings.exampleTr: Roman üçüncü şahıs ağzından yazılmıştır, bu yüzden anlatıcı bir karakter değildir.

meanings.en: used to introduce the third point in a list
meanings.exampleEn: Thirdly, we must consider the cost of the project.
meanings.exampleTr: Üçüncü olarak, projenin maliyetini göz önünde bulundurmalıyız.

meanings.en: the feeling of needing to drink something
meanings.exampleEn: After the long hike, his thirst was unbearable.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun yürüyüşten sonra susuzluğu dayanılmazdı.

meanings.en: completely and carefully
meanings.exampleEn: Please wash your hands thoroughly before cooking.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen yemek pişirmeden önce ellerinizi iyice yıkayın.

meanings.en: however; used to add a contrasting point
meanings.exampleEn: It's expensive. I'll buy it, though.
meanings.exampleTr: Pahalı. Yine de onu alacağım.

meanings.en: showing careful thought or care for others
meanings.exampleEn: It was very thoughtful of you to remember my birthday.
meanings.exampleTr: Doğum günümü hatırlaman çok düşünceliydi.

meanings.en: not thinking about the feelings or needs of others
meanings.exampleEn: His thoughtless comment hurt her feelings.
meanings.exampleTr: Düşüncesiz yorumu onun duygularını incitti.

meanings.en: a thin strand of cotton or other material used for sewing
meanings.exampleEn: She used a needle and thread to fix the button.
meanings.exampleTr: Düğmeyi tamir etmek için iğne ve iplik kullandı.

meanings.en: to say you will harm someone or put something in danger
meanings.exampleEn: The rising sea levels threaten coastal cities.
meanings.exampleTr: Yükselen deniz seviyeleri kıyı kentlerini tehdit ediyor.

meanings.en: a sudden feeling of great excitement or pleasure
meanings.exampleEn: Riding the roller coaster gave her a real thrill.
meanings.exampleTr: Hız trenine binmek ona gerçek bir heyecan verdi.

meanings.en: very excited and pleased
meanings.exampleEn: She was thrilled to hear that she had won the prize.
meanings.exampleTr: Ödülü kazandığını duyunca çok heyecanlandı.

meanings.en: very exciting and enjoyable
meanings.exampleEn: The match had a thrilling finish in the last minute.
meanings.exampleTr: Maç son dakikada heyecan verici bir bitişe sahne oldu.

meanings.en: the passage from the back of the mouth to the stomach and lungs
meanings.exampleEn: I have a sore throat and can barely speak.
meanings.exampleTr: Boğazım ağrıyor ve neredeyse konuşamıyorum.

meanings.en: to touch someone lightly to make them laugh
meanings.exampleEn: The father loves to tickle his children until they giggle.
meanings.exampleTr: Baba çocuklarını kıkırdayana kadar gıdıklamayı çok sever.

meanings.en: a tightly stretched rope on which acrobats walk
meanings.exampleEn: The acrobat walked across the tightrope without a safety net.
meanings.exampleTr: Cambaz güvenlik ağı olmadan gergin ipin üzerinde yürüdü.

meanings.en: not affected by the passing of time; always remaining good
meanings.exampleEn: This dress has a timeless elegance that never goes out of style.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu elbise asla modası geçmeyen zamansız bir zarafete sahip.

meanings.en: the quality of happening at the right or best moment
meanings.exampleEn: The timeliness of the warning saved many lives.
meanings.exampleTr: Uyarının zamanında yapılması birçok hayat kurtardı.

meanings.en: the choosing of when to do something for the best effect
meanings.exampleEn: The timing of the announcement was perfect.
meanings.exampleTr: Duyurunun zamanlaması mükemmeldi.

meanings.en: to walk quietly on the tips of your toes
meanings.exampleEn: She tiptoed into the room so as not to wake the baby.
meanings.exampleTr: Bebeği uyandırmamak için odaya parmak uçlarında girdi.

meanings.en: the state of needing rest or sleep
meanings.exampleEn: After the long shift, her tiredness was obvious.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun vardiyadan sonra yorgunluğu belliydi.

meanings.en: making you feel annoyed or bored
meanings.exampleEn: Filling out the same forms every month is tiresome.
meanings.exampleTr: Her ay aynı formları doldurmak can sıkıcı.

meanings.en: the hard covering at the end of a toe
meanings.exampleEn: He cut his toenails after taking a shower.
meanings.exampleTr: Duş aldıktan sonra ayak tırnaklarını kesti.

meanings.en: to work very hard for a long time
meanings.exampleEn: The farmers toiled in the fields from dawn to dusk.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiftçiler şafaktan akşama kadar tarlalarda didindi.

meanings.en: willing to accept beliefs or behavior different from your own
meanings.exampleEn: A good leader should be tolerant of different opinions.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi bir lider farklı görüşlere karşı hoşgörülü olmalıdır.

meanings.en: to accept or endure something unpleasant
meanings.exampleEn: I can't tolerate rude behavior from my employees.
meanings.exampleTr: Çalışanlarımdan kaba davranışlara katlanamam.

meanings.en: a payment for using a road or bridge
meanings.exampleEn: We had to pay a toll to cross the bridge.
meanings.exampleTr: Köprüden geçmek için geçiş ücreti ödemek zorunda kaldık.

meanings.en: a large grave, especially one built of stone
meanings.exampleEn: Tourists visited the ancient tomb of the pharaoh.
meanings.exampleTr: Turistler firavunun antik mezarını ziyaret etti.

meanings.en: a unit of weight equal to about 1,000 kilograms
meanings.exampleEn: The truck was carrying ten tons of coal.
meanings.exampleTr: Kamyon on ton kömür taşıyordu.

meanings.en: a small electric light carried in the hand, or a burning stick
meanings.exampleEn: He shone his torch into the dark cave.
meanings.exampleTr: El fenerini karanlık mağaraya tuttu.

meanings.en: the brown and yellow shell of a turtle, used for decoration
meanings.exampleEn: The glasses had frames made of tortoiseshell.
meanings.exampleTr: Gözlüğün çerçeveleri bağadan yapılmıştı.

meanings.en: to cause severe pain to someone deliberately
meanings.exampleEn: The prisoners were tortured to make them confess.
meanings.exampleTr: Tutuklular itiraf etmeleri için işkence gördü.

meanings.en: difficult to do, or strong and not easily damaged
meanings.exampleEn: Losing his job was a tough time for the whole family.
meanings.exampleTr: İşini kaybetmesi tüm aile için zor bir dönemdi.

meanings.en: containing poison; very harmful
meanings.exampleEn: The factory released toxic chemicals into the river.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika nehre zehirli kimyasallar bıraktı.

meanings.en: a person who buys and sells goods or shares
meanings.exampleEn: The trader made a profit by buying and selling stocks.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüccar hisse senedi alıp satarak kâr elde etti.

meanings.en: a person who is learning and practicing a job
meanings.exampleEn: The new trainee is learning how to use the software.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni stajyer yazılımı nasıl kullanacağını öğreniyor.

meanings.en: a person who teaches skills to people or animals
meanings.exampleEn: The personal trainer designed a workout plan for me.
meanings.exampleTr: Kişisel antrenör benim için bir antrenman planı hazırladı.

meanings.en: a particular quality of a person's character
meanings.exampleEn: Patience is a valuable trait in a teacher.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabır, bir öğretmende değerli bir özelliktir.

meanings.en: a person who betrays their country or friends
meanings.exampleEn: He was called a traitor for selling secrets to the enemy.
meanings.exampleTr: Düşmana sır sattığı için hain olarak adlandırıldı.

meanings.en: a person with no home or job who travels from place to place
meanings.exampleEn: An old tramp slept on the park bench every night.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı bir serseri her gece park bankında uyurdu.

meanings.en: the act of stepping heavily on something and crushing it
meanings.exampleEn: The trample of the panicked crowd destroyed the flower beds.
meanings.exampleTr: Panik içindeki kalabalığın çiğnemesi çiçek tarhlarını mahvetti.

meanings.en: a written copy of spoken words or a record of grades
meanings.exampleEn: The lawyer read the transcript of the witness's testimony.
meanings.exampleTr: Avukat tanığın ifadesinin yazılı kaydını okudu.

meanings.en: the act of moving someone or something to another place
meanings.exampleEn: He requested a transfer to the London office.
meanings.exampleTr: Londra ofisine transfer talebinde bulundu.

meanings.en: the process of putting blood into a person's body
meanings.exampleEn: The accident victim needed an urgent blood transfusion.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaza kurbanının acil kan nakline ihtiyacı vardı.

meanings.en: lasting for only a short time
meanings.exampleEn: Fame can be transient, disappearing as quickly as it comes.
meanings.exampleTr: Şöhret geçici olabilir, geldiği kadar hızlı kaybolur.

meanings.en: a small electronic device that controls electric current
meanings.exampleEn: Modern computers contain billions of transistors.
meanings.exampleTr: Modern bilgisayarlar milyarlarca transistör içerir.

meanings.en: the process of changing from one state to another
meanings.exampleEn: The transition from school to university can be difficult.
meanings.exampleTr: Okuldan üniversiteye geçiş zor olabilir.

meanings.en: describing a verb that needs a direct object
meanings.exampleEn: The verb 'buy' is transitive because it needs an object.
meanings.exampleTr: 'Satın almak' fiili geçişlidir çünkü bir nesneye ihtiyaç duyar.

meanings.en: the process of changing words from one language to another
meanings.exampleEn: The English translation of the novel sold very well.
meanings.exampleTr: Romanın İngilizce çevirisi çok iyi sattı.

meanings.en: a person who changes written words into another language
meanings.exampleEn: She works as a translator for the United Nations.
meanings.exampleTr: Birleşmiş Milletler için çevirmen olarak çalışıyor.

meanings.en: the act of sending or passing something from one place to another
meanings.exampleEn: The transmission of the disease can be prevented by washing hands.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalığın bulaşması el yıkayarak önlenebilir.

meanings.en: to send or pass something from one place or person to another
meanings.exampleEn: The station transmits its signal across the whole country.
meanings.exampleTr: İstasyon sinyalini tüm ülkeye iletir.

meanings.en: an act of crossing or moving across something
meanings.exampleEn: The climbers made a difficult traverse across the icy slope.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağcılar buzlu yamaçta zorlu bir geçiş yaptı.

meanings.en: a flat object used for carrying food or drinks
meanings.exampleEn: The waiter carried the drinks on a silver tray.
meanings.exampleTr: Garson içecekleri gümüş bir tepside taşıdı.

meanings.en: to put your foot down while walking or stepping
meanings.exampleEn: Be careful not to tread on the broken glass.

meanings.exampleEn: The two nations signed a peace treaty to end the war.
meanings.exampleTr: İki ulus savaşı bitirmek için bir barış antlaşması imzaladı.

meanings.en: a long and difficult journey on foot
meanings.exampleEn: They went on a three-day trek through the mountains.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağlarda üç günlük zorlu bir yürüyüşe çıktılar.

meanings.en: to a very great degree; extremely
meanings.exampleEn: The new policy helped the company tremendously.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni politika şirkete son derece yardımcı oldu.

meanings.en: a small shaking movement or a slight earthquake
meanings.exampleEn: A small tremor shook the buildings during the night.
meanings.exampleTr: Gece boyunca küçük bir sarsıntı binaları salladı.

meanings.en: a legal process in court, or a test of something
meanings.exampleEn: The trial lasted three weeks before the jury reached a verdict.
meanings.exampleTr: Jüri bir karara varmadan önce duruşma üç hafta sürdü.

meanings.en: a flat shape with three sides and three angles
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher drew a triangle on the whiteboard.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen beyaz tahtaya bir üçgen çizdi.

meanings.en: a group of people who share a culture, language, and ancestry
meanings.exampleEn: The tribe has lived in the rainforest for centuries.
meanings.exampleTr: Kabile yüzyıllardır yağmur ormanında yaşıyor.
